questions.subject: Physics
questions.topic: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
questions.question: The rotational analogue of force in linear motion is:
questions.explanation: Torque τ = Iα parallels F = ma, with moment of inertia playing the role of mass and angular momentum that of linear momentum.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 6: System of Particles and Rotational Motion

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: For an ideal gas, the relation between the molar specific heats is Cp - Cv = R. The ratio Cp/Cv for a monatomic gas is:
questions.explanation: A monatomic gas has f = 3, so Cv = 3R/2 and Cp = 5R/2, giving γ = 5/3 = 1.67. Diatomic gases give 1.4.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A step-up transformer increases the voltage. In an ideal transformer this is accompanied by:
options: A proportionate decrease in current, keeping power the same
questions.explanation: An ideal transformer conserves power, so VpIp = VsIs. Raising voltage lowers current, which is exactly why power is transmitted at high voltage to cut I²R losses.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The electronic configuration of chromium (Z = 24) in its ground state is:
questions.explanation: One 4s electron shifts to 3d because a half-filled d subshell is extra stable, thanks to symmetrical distribution and greater exchange energy. Copper is stable as 3d¹⁰ 4s¹ for the same reason.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.question: Which of the following groups is an ortho and para directing but deactivating substituent on a benzene ring?
questions.explanation: Chlorine withdraws electrons by the -I effect, making the ring less reactive, but its lone pair enters the ring by resonance and directs incoming groups to the ortho and para positions.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 8: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The correct order of reactivity towards nucleophilic addition is:
options: All react at the same rate
questions.explanation: Alkyl groups both reduce the positive charge on the carbonyl carbon and block the approach of the nucleophile, so reactivity falls as their number rises.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 8: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In the binomial name Mangifera indica, the word indica represents the:
questions.explanation: The first word is the genus and begins with a capital letter, the second is the specific epithet in small letters, and both are printed in italics or underlined when handwritten.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 1: The Living World

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The rate of production of organic matter by producers per unit area per unit time is called:
questions.explanation: Net primary productivity is what is left after the plants' own respiration, and it is this that becomes available to herbivores.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Accumulation of uric acid crystals in the joints causing their inflammation is known as:
questions.explanation: Osteoporosis is loss of bone mass from low oestrogen, and myasthenia gravis is an autoimmune block at the neuromuscular junction.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 17: Locomotion and Movement

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Human insulin produced by recombinant DNA technology and marketed as humulin was made by inserting the genes for:
options: The A and B polypeptide chains into E. coli
The C peptide into E. coli
questions.explanation: Eli Lilly produced the two chains separately in E. coli and then joined them by disulphide bonds, avoiding the allergy that animal insulin sometimes caused.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 10: Biotechnology and its Applications
